author: oRohan
body:
Hello senior staff members of avicus. I'm going to try and get right to the point on most of this and I hope you consider my application. Thank you for this opportunity. 

Age: 13 (as of February 27)
Timezone: EST (Eastern Standard Time)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes I do.
Do you have access to Skype? I have Skype as well.
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes, I have bandicam as well as windows 10 recording software.
Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? Sadly, I have not been able to expose myself to staff mainly because of my age. Some servers do not approve of my young age, as stated above, I am 13 years old. This is very heart breaking to me because I am on the more mature side of my age.
What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is that I really cannot tolerate racism at all. Me being a brown colored person makes me a target for these things. I break down to these things. I believe it will affect me by not issuing warnings to people who are racist and I will probably have to learn how to give warnings to racists before you take the proper steps of action. This can be easily done because I am very tolerant. This is a great attribute of mine and I love it so much!
What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? My biggest strength would possibly be my sense of humor. I could help newer people feel right at home by joking around with them. This will surely attract more attention to our "little community" that we have here on Avicus.
How do you believe you can help improve the staff team? I could be a positive addition to the staff team due to my hours. I am usually on when not a lot of staff are on, so this will strengthen our cut down on hackers. Being a player very often, I get to see these atrocities that happen when hackers are on. It will save everyone the frustration.
What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Virtues of a good leader in my opinion are that you never leave anyone behind, you don't hesitate to take action, and you take any advice that you may think is beneficial to both you and the community. This is mainly why I strive to be a best leader I can be. This also can help me or hurt me. The help is worth way more than the hurt though!
Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? Not to be arrogant, but I do see myself as a leader. I think this because I love helping others and I'm always open to any advice. I am also very glad for these amazing attributes I was born with.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? My strongest attributes are that I have a special connection to the community and I know numerous moderators and I have really good relationships with them.
What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? I believe the skills needed when interacting with the community are that you must know the basics of minecraft, be good at pvp, and make decisions that benefit the team, not only yourself. This will surely be able to make you a friendly, likeable person on this community.
Do you believe you have these skills? Again, not to be arrogant, but I do think I have proper skills when interacting with the community. There is always room to improve though!
How much time can you commit to being a staff member? I can be online around 3-4 hours on weekdays and 6-7 hours on weekends. This can change because I have soccer and I go on trips often.
You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? I would take the /reports first, look at them, get proof, then I would temporarily ban the ban evader (highest form of punishment available for Jr Mods) and then I would go on team speak and find an available moderator. The moderator would then take the proper steps needed to ban the hacker.
Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also a referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? First I would join the channel that they are all in. I would then record the harassment and then show it to the senior staff, admins, and possibly owners. Then they have evidence in order to discharge that staff member of their duties. 
A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realize that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore is no physical evidence. You know however this person broke the rules, what would you do? First, I would go to any staff on at the time and see if they had any evidence. Then, if the staff members on at the time did not have anything, I would go to the community and ask witnesses with evidence about what happened. If those two tasks do not work, you cannot do anything, so you just let the player go.
You are in an avicus team. One of your teammates is also an avicus staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn't very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything,what would you do? I would first run it by the person/ staff member if I could post it publicly. If he says no then no further action will be taken.
One day the senior staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of he decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do? I would request to get in a chat with all the senior staff and get briefed on what the decision was and then I would put in questions, comments, or concerns to them.
What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? It would mean a lot because this lets me know that people trust me and think that I would be a good addition to their team.
How passionate are you about avicus? I was introduced to this server in January of 2014 and I've fell in love with it. 
What does avicus mean to you? It means the world to me. I spend 80% of my time on minecraft to this server and if it shut down, I would probably stop playing minecraft.
Do you speak any other languages other than English? I speak chinese (simplified) and Spanish as well.
Do you have anything else to add to your application? I just wanted to say thank you for the opportunity again and I love your server. I also typed everything (even the questions) out. I hope you will consider. This is how passionate about being staff on my favorite sever. Thank you!
